title: The End Tarot Reaper
description: A surreal fantasy painting depicts a white winged figure with a red and white face, long purple snake, and staff, seated on a cliff edge covered in colorful flowers. In the foreground are scattered tarot cards, a wooden sign reading 'THE END', a stone bridge over a green river, a castle, a green dragon, and snow-capped mountains under a purple night sky with a crescent moon.
prompt: A surreal fantasy scene of a pale winged figure with a split red and white face, wearing a crown of flowers, sitting on a flower-covered cliff. A large purple snake coils around his body and he holds a golden staff. In the foreground are scattered tarot cards and a wooden sign that says THE END. A stone bridge crosses a glowing green river leading to a purple castle and a green dragon on a rock. Snow-capped purple mountains rise in the background under a starry twilight sky with a bright crescent moon and swirling patterns.
